metadata.title: Only Yours — Your private workspace for notes, secrets and automations
metadata.description: Only Yours is an open-source self-hosted app for managing notes, encrypted secrets, scenarios and automations.

common.tagline: Your private workspace for notes, secrets, scenarios and automations.

landing.title: Yours. Nobody else's.
landing.subtitle: Only Yours is a private workspace for notes, encrypted secrets, scenarios and automations — run it locally or on your own hosting.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Quick notes with tags, search and a trash bin. Markdown-friendly.

vault.title: Secrets vault
vault.description: End-to-end encryption in your browser. The server never sees your passwords.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.description: Step-by-step procedures and checklists — from runbooks to travel plans.

automations.title: Automations
automations.description: Create notes and scenarios from templates, call webhooks.

security.title: Progressive security
security.description: Google sign-in is enough for everyday work. Critical features require MFA, and the vault additionally requires a local master-password unlock.

auth.signInSubtitle: Use your Google account to enter your private workspace.
auth.sessionNote: Signing in grants access to notes and scenarios. The vault and security settings additionally require MFA.

securityCard.title: Security status
securityCard.mfaOn: MFA is enabled. Critical features are protected.
securityCard.mfaOff: MFA is not configured. The vault and critical actions are unavailable.

empty.title: No notes
empty.description: Start with your first note — everything stays only with you.

empty.title: No scenarios
empty.description: A scenario is a procedure or checklist — steps you tick off.

steps.title: Steps
steps.empty: This scenario has no steps yet.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this scenario?
confirmDelete.description: All steps will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.

vault.title: Vault
vault.subtitle: Secrets encrypted in your browser. The server stores only encrypted data.
vault.autoLockNote: The vault locks automatically after {minutes} min of inactivity.

mfaSetupCard.title: Set up MFA first
mfaSetupCard.description: The vault holds your most sensitive data, so it requires multi-factor authentication. Setup takes about 2 minutes.

stepUpCard.title: Confirm your identity
stepUpCard.description: Vault access requires a fresh MFA verification in this session.

createCard.title: Create your vault
createCard.description: Set a master password. An encryption key is derived from it in your browser — it never leaves your device.
createCard.tooShort: The master password must be at least 12 characters long.
createCard.warning: The master password cannot be recovered. If you lose it, your vault data is gone for good — we have no way to decrypt it.

unlockCard.title: Unlock vault
unlockCard.description: Enter your master password to decrypt secrets locally.

empty.title: Vault is empty
empty.description: Add your first password or secret. Everything is encrypted before it leaves the browser.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this entry?
confirmDelete.description: The entry will be permanently removed from the vault.

export.description: The export contains only encrypted data — the master password is required to read it.
export.freshMfa: Export requires a fresh MFA verification.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.confirmDescription: All secrets will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. Fresh MFA verification required.
danger.freshMfa: Deleting the vault requires a fresh MFA verification.

e2eNote.title: End-to-end encryption
e2eNote.description: The master password and decrypted secrets exist only in your browser's memory. The server sees encrypted blobs only.

setup.title: MFA setup (TOTP)
setup.intro: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password…), then enter the 6-digit code.
setup.manualEntry: Can't scan? Enter the secret manually:

backupCodes.title: Backup codes
backupCodes.description: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each works only once and you are seeing them for the only time. Use them if you lose access to your authenticator app.
backupCodes.confirm: I have saved my backup codes

stepUp.title: MFA verification
stepUp.description: This action requires a second factor.
stepUp.freshDescription: This action requires a fresh verification — enter a code again.

errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Verification locked for 15 minutes.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: MFA, backup codes and the security event log.

mfa.title: Multi-factor authentication
mfa.description: TOTP codes from an authenticator app protect the vault and critical actions.

backupCodes.title: Backup codes
backupCodes.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {No unused codes left} one {# unused code} other {# unused codes}}
backupCodes.regenerateNote: New codes invalidate all previous ones. Fresh MFA verification required.

stepUp.title: Session elevation
stepUp.none: No active MFA verification in this session.

levels.title: Access levels
levels.vault: Local unlock — reading secrets in the browser

automations.title: Automations

empty.title: No automations
empty.description: Automations create notes and scenarios from templates or call webhooks.

automations.triggerNote: Schedules and incoming webhooks need a worker/cron — the MVP executes the manual trigger. The data model is already in place.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this automation?
confirmDelete.description: Run history will be deleted too.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Connections to external services. Tokens are encrypted at rest and never reach the browser.
integrations.mfaNote: Adding an integration will require MFA verification.

GOOGLE_CALENDAR.name: Google Calendar
GOOGLE_CALENDAR.description: Sync events and create notes from meetings.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED: This action requires MFA to be configured.
errors.MFA_LOCKED: MFA verification is temporarily locked. Try again later.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again.

footer.openSource: Open source under the MIT license
footer.selfHosted: Self-hosted — your data stays with you
